summary: The blessed water quaff reaches potion.c:peffect_water, but js/potion.js throws UnsupportedQuaffError. C’s non-chaotic, non-undead blessed arm says the hero feels full of awe, clears sickness, and exercises wisdom and constitution. Port the whole water effect, including neutral hunger, chaotic/undead, cursed, lycanthropy, and polymorph branches with source-ordered messages, RNG, and state changes.

source.branch: potion.c:peffect_water (717-767) first distinguishes neutral from blessed/cursed water. Neutral draws rnd(10) for hunger and calls newuhs. Blessed or cursed increments potion_unkn, then branches on mon_hates_blessings or chaotic alignment. Blessed ordinary hero says full of awe, clears sickness, and exercises attributes; opposite-alignment and lycanthropy arms can burn, heal, polymorph, or cure. Preserve d(2,6), Maybe_Half_Phys, and killer formatting where reached.

potion.c:dodrink -> dopotion -> peffects reaches the effect for an ordinary water quaff; sink and other potion creation paths can call dopotion.
dependencies: Existing or newly completed mon_hates_blessings, make_sick, newuhs, healup, losehp, exercise, and lycanthropy helpers must be invoked in C order. If C consumes a missing helper return, port that callee in the same task.
Delete the UnsupportedQuaffError site when the whole effect is wired; do not special-case the blessed v9 recipe.
